title: Households with Access to Electricity
description: Number of households with access to electricity at home.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at yearly frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] Either Malaysia, Semenanjung Malaysia (supplied by Tenaga Nasional Berhad), Sabah (supplied by Sabah Electricity Sdn. Bhd.), or Sarawak (supplied by Sarawak Energy Berhad)

fields.name: households
fields.title: Households
fields.description: [Float] Number of households with access to electricity at home

methodology: In Malaysia, the electrical grid is operated by various parties, primarily Tenaga Nasional Berhad (for Peninsular Malaysia), Sabah Electricity Sdn. Bhd., and Sarawak Energy Berhad. Independent power producers also contribute to the grid. This dataset is tabulated from the operational records of these providers, and shows the number of households (i.e. domestic consumers) with access to electricity at home.
